tool_args.rationale: The pilot is monotone and concave, and the acquired probe expands the sink-gradient range. Fit the plausible archived sink-dependent mechanisms numerically and use fresh confirmation to test the best-fitting candidate. The previous confirmation attempt failed at parsing, so it supplied no evidence against the mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The wider-gradient observations make the archived static sink-dependent families testable; no observed time dependence presently warrants a trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.option: Siphon, cooperative Hill, and barrier-modulated siphon models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: None is assumed in advance; numerical training residual selects among these competing mechanisms for fresh confirmation.
It does not discriminate the candidate mechanisms.
